environment.primary: packaged macOS arm64 App, dedicated synthetic project, no model/CLI task during measurement
environment.baseline: fresh app; one warmup open/close per sample shape; 10s idle before baseline
environment.sampling: unique App-owned PIDs only; 100ms RSS samples during active phase; close then 2s idle and explicit GC only for post-GC JS comparison; report actual sampling gaps
environment.unsupportedMetrics: missing renderer/worker/GPU measurement is not pass

pdf.perRound: open fixed2000page sample; first->last->first; zoom largest supported; close; every fifth round additionally rotate/CJK/AcroForm variants in same session; no source mutations
pdf.notes: canvas bytes = width*height*4; cap applies to body plus thumbnails; reduce render resolution or postpone offscreen render without truncating pages

roundProfiles: large raster output with explicit pixel metadata
notebook.requirements: full original outputs and all cells remain accessible; scheduling must not permanently crop/drop content; image scaling must avoid unbounded full-resolution decode; exceed-target cases must be fixed or explicitly reviewed, not marked pass by silent MIME fallback

memory.baseline: after same-shape warmup, not empty OS/browser
memory.counting: deduplicate PID when worker runs in renderer; include helper processes in App total; separate process RSS from canvas byte accounting
memory.interpretation: engineering acceptance targets selected before real-App measurements, not inferred successes from current isolated probes; RSS may include allocator/font/GPU caches; stable retained cache must still fit both absolute/delta gates

failurePolicy: Record the exact failing metric and build. Repair scheduling/decoding/release and rerun affected series. Do not widen the budget after seeing results without a documented reason and synchronized design/acceptance baseline. Do not reduce confirmed feature scope solely to claim a pass.
